requirements.statement: A customer can complete a password reset, replacing the password used to access the account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer is completing a valid password reset, when the customer sets a new password and completes the reset, then the new password can be used to sign in and the former password cannot.

requirements.statement: The sign-in page offers a "Forgot password?" link that starts a password reset request.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sign-in page is displayed, when a customer selects "Forgot password?", then the password reset request process starts.

requirements.statement: The response to a password reset request is identical whether or not the account exists.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing account and a nonexistent account, when an otherwise equivalent reset request is made for each, then the request responses are identical.

requirements.statement: Reset requests are limited to five per account per hour.
acceptance_criteria: Given five reset requests have already been made for an account within an hour, when a sixth request is made for that account within the same hour, then it does not issue an additional reset link.
Given an unused, unexpired reset link, when it is used to complete a successful reset, then a subsequent attempt to reset a password with that same link cannot succeed.

requirements.statement: A reset link expires 30 minutes after it is issued.
acceptance_criteria: Given an unused reset link and its issue time, when a reset is attempted with that link at or after 30 minutes from issue, then the link cannot complete the reset.

requirements.statement: Completing a password reset signs the account out of every active session.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account has multiple active sessions, when its password reset completes, then none of those sessions remains signed in.

requirements.statement: The account owner is notified after every successful password reset.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account owner and a successful password reset for that account, when the reset completes, then that owner is notified about that reset; each subsequent successful reset likewise results in an owner notification.
